entries.source_name: A Chat in the Snowy Mountains
entries.description_en: Go to Dragonspine, place your tea table, and have Sandrone take a seat. Then, prepare to enjoy some tea with Albedo...

Not long after the meeting in the land of snow concluded, ships crowded the waters beyond Liyue Harbor, while the Millelith, the Qixing, and the adepti joined forces to bring the initial chaos under control.\nWith order restored, Liyue did not stop at defending itself, but turned to dispatch manpower and supplies to more distant front lines...

On the deck of the Alcor, people from different nations raise their cups together, toasting to a tomorrow yet to come.\nThis celebration is not the end, but a chance to remind one another: Hope remains, and our companions are still by our side.

Under the blight of the "Holy Soil phenomenon," ancient seals have loosened, and filth from the Ley Lines has surfaced once more.\nSheltered by the Narukami and united in the purification ritual, people call upon lightning to clear the filth and shared wishes to quell disaster, driving back the recurring evil time and time again.

Within the House of Daena, research, logistics, rescue missions, and combat operations are underway all at once, while the forces of the rainforest and the desert unite along the same front.\nFacing chaotic Ley Lines and an expanding crisis, Sumeru relies on knowledge to coordinate the battle, and decisive action to answer the danger.

Before the calamity struck head-on, Fontaine became a crucial hub for transit and shelter across the lands.\nVessels, medics, and rear bases came together to form a floating defensive line, turning this nation of water still spared a moment to breathe into a haven bearing the wounds and hopes of all nations.

When the calamity erupted on a massive scale, Natlan found itself on the fiercest front of the disaster, where ruins, casualties, and sacrifice had become all too familiar...\nAfter bidding farewell to the fallen, the living step onto the battlefield once more. So long as the spark remains, this land will never stop fighting back.

Mourning did not slow their steps. Instead, it made every survivor see clearly what they are fighting for.\nMarching on in the name of the fallen, they let the still-burning flames light the way to a tomorrow yet to come.

Facing the expanding threat of the "Holy Soil phenomenon," everyone has had to change.\nPast stances have not truly vanished, but differences must ultimately yield to a more realistic choice: Friend and foe are decided by circumstance in the end, and at this moment, they must march side by side.

entries.source_name: The Sunken Ship Sailed Past, Ringing No Bells
entries.arabic_name: أبحرت السفينة الغارقة دون أن تقرع جرساً
entries.description_en: A wooden cabin has come to a stop above the water. This rather familiar house may currently play host to a certain old acquaintance. Is he in trouble again? Head over to ascertain the situation...

The cabin on the ice seems but a hair's breadth from sinking into the sea. What happened while you were gone? Is the owner of the house, who refused to get ashore, still in there? Approach the cabin to check it out.
Some time later, the investigation made a breakthrough...

entries.source_name: Dark Clouds in a Wine Bottle
entries.description_en: Mitya appears to have something on his mind...
Miners have noticed that the lights in one area seem to flicker in a pattern. Could this also be connected to the recent Kresnik Kristall heist...?
The engineering supervisor, Sobolev, seems to need help...

entries.source_name: Variations on Belyi and Chernyi: Schedule
entries.description_en: Odette's schedule proceeds...

entries.source_name: Variations on Belyi and Chernyi: Schedule
entries.description_en: Odette's schedule proceeds...

entries.source_name: Variations on Belyi and Chernyi: Schedule
entries.description_en: Odette's schedule proceeds...

Over the years, the Transport Bureau's authority has expanded time and again. Like a giant behemoth, there is always tissue dying off. And like a grand palace, there is always dust accumulating... Now, at last, it is in dire need of a thorough "cleaning."
The unexpected incident has been resolved. Now, you can finally enter Novokitezhgrad trouble-free.
The Blightkristall disaster has abated, and you have witnessed Thrud's final fate... Perhaps you should tell Glinin and Koshkin all that has transpired.

The old case may be closed, but the scars left by the storm remain, both within the Rail Transport Bureau and beyond its walls.\nThe storm has yet to pass, but some still tend the lights of dawn, holding out hope that order, long buried in dust, will one day be restored.
Two fae are arguing on the bridge, and if they're left to their own devices, things could quickly spiral out of hand. Perhaps it's time to step in and smooth things over...

entries.source_name: Better a Finch in the Hand
entries.arabic_name: عصفور في اليد خير من عشرة على الشجرة
entries.description_en: A businessman earnestly invites you to try his game, claiming that many have already amassed a fortune through it. Perhaps only by experiencing it firsthand can one discover the secrets hidden within...

entries.source_name: The Kind Soul Who Brings Bread
entries.description_en: A fishy merchant stops you at the train station...
You hear a joyful voice coming from outside the shelter on the snowy plains...
While heading to the Snezhnaya Adventurers' Guild Headquarters, you and Paimon are stopped in your tracks by two "S-rank" adventurers...
Something strange appears to be happening with the Nail of Retribution all across Teyvat. Go check out what's going on.

entries.source_name: The Way of Mutual Aid and Advancement?
entries.description_en: Having finally made it to Snezhnaya, you and Paimon decide to stop by Morepesok when you have the chance...

entries.source_name: A Promise to Share Our Tips...
entries.description_en: The exploration plan is nearly complete after some easygoing teamwork with the children of the Mutual Aid Advancement Network. Chichikova seems to have come away with a few new discoveries of her own...
Something strange appears to be happening with the Nail of Retribution all across Teyvat. Go check out what's going on.
Something strange appears to be happening with the Nail of Retribution all across Teyvat. Go check out what's going on.
Something strange appears to be happening with the Nail of Retribution all across Teyvat. Go check out what's going on.
Something strange appears to be happening with the Nail of Retribution all across Teyvat. Go check out what's going on.
Something strange appears to be happening with the Nail of Retribution all across Teyvat. Go check out what's going on.
You and Paimon have won the first Adventurers' Tournament. Rewards from Snezhnaya Headquarters should be on the way, along with a few rather unusual questions...

While strolling across the snowy fields, you have a chance encounter with Alyosha, who was hidden behind a pile of snow. According to him, this is normal behavior for a hunter, but soon, you realize that he has chosen somewhat special "prey" this time around...
You bump into Alyosha near a station. He wants to do something for this particular station...
The furnace grows hotter and stronger, and life at the shelter has finally stabilized...
You recall the pedestal that you and Alyosha found earlier. It seems to have something to do with the Shadow Realm...
As you continue upgrading your access card, you activate a hidden space...
You have finally finished your excavation of the relics within the ruins
It seems like there's something awaiting everyone's involvement to take care of...
As you pass by the Druzhna HQ, you notice a very special selection process underway...

entries.arabic_name: ظلال تلوح في الأفق: الجزء الأول
entries.description_en: Of all known "disasters," Yarovaya suspects the Shadow Realm may be the most unstable. Whatever dangers lie hidden within must be dealt with before they can worsen...

entries.description_en: Of all known "disasters," Yarovaya suspects the Shadow Realm may be the most unstable. Whatever dangers lie hidden within must be dealt with before they can worsen...
The two of you receive a letter from Vesna out of the blue: you've been invited to claim a "prize." But as to just what this "prize" is, she did not say...
The Tsaritsa agrees to sit for a new portrait at the urging of her retainers. But it seems that she has some concerns that may not be confined to the painter's easel alone...
The Tsaritsa invites you to attend an assembly of the court. According to Vesna, you have a special job at the assembly, and you'll have to do your best...
What kind of gifts do the children of Snezhnaya like? This is a question that even the Tsaritsa is pondering and needs your help with...

entries.source_name: A Winter's Night. Proper Ladies. Tea Party.
entries.arabic_name: ليلة شتوية. سيدات محترمات. حفلة شاي.
entries.description_en: For Paimon, the tea party is a great way to catch up with friends over tea and snacks. However, this seems to be an experience that is utterly foreign to the Tsaritsa...
The Tsaritsa invites you to a battle of wits as a way to better understand how you approach problems. However, one could also see this not just as a battle, but a long heart-to-heart talk...
You wonder how things are going at Rankova Zorya. Might as well head over and have a look...

entries.source_name: One Yet to Take a Bow
entries.description_en: You hear rumors that eerie music sometimes echoes from the Korolevskiy Theater around midnight, and that people have even seen shadows dancing on the walls...
With these materials in hand, Odette should be able to repair her music box...
Talalikhin, an adventurer devoted to researching dangerous phenomena, is conducting some form of simulation training near the Adventurers' Guild Headquarters...
In Snezhnaya, the two of you spot the rather familiar Adventurers' Guild...
Most people associate Teplo Oasis with its beautiful scenery and bountiful crops. Few know that it is also home to the finest brewery in the area. Stop by sometime. You might just run into a friend.
Holidays must eventually come to an end, but the friends you meet along the way can remain a part of your life for a long time to come.
The Tsaritsa has a new assignment for you, one that seems to have something to do with the eating habits of Snezhnaya's people...

entries.source_name: The Army That Stares Down Winter
entries.description_en: This assignment seems to have something to do with Vesna. You and Paimon both suspect it might be a prank...
Over the course of your journey, you've seen plenty of the weaponry and technology used by the Fatui. As it turns out, they're also related to your latest assignment...
When it comes to finances, Paimon's idea of a financial plan is secretly stashing Mora away in a piggy bank...
The Tsaritsa has a habit of making regular inspection tours by train, and it seems she has something a little different in mind this time...
The Tsaritsa has once again invited you to help her analyze an endgame...
While passing southwest of Morepesok, you unexpectedly encounter a Frost Operative playing with a group of children...
Some time has passed since your meeting with Regrator. As you happen to pass by the Northland Bank, you decide to check how sales are going for that matryoshka doll...
You encounter a film enthusiast devoted to studying cinematography in Snezhnograd...
